mcqs.q: What is the full form of IoT?
mcqs.explanation: IoT means Internet of Things: connected physical objects that exchange data.

mcqs.q: IoT is based on which technology?
mcqs.explanation: Connected devices use physical hardware and software together.

mcqs.q: Which feature is commonly expected in an IoT device?
mcqs.explanation: Network connectivity permits remote monitoring and control.

mcqs.q: Which is NOT normally an IoT device without additional electronics?
mcqs.explanation: An ordinary table has no sensors, computing or network connection.
mcqs.note: Original paper uses “Table”; other choices differ only in presentation.

mcqs.q: Which device is NOT typically an IoT device?
mcqs.explanation: A basic calculator does not communicate as a connected IoT endpoint.
mcqs.note: Some advanced calculators could connect; the PYQ intends a basic calculator.

mcqs.q: Which component captures data from the physical world?
mcqs.explanation: Sensors convert physical measurements into electrical/digital data.

mcqs.q: Which device converts a control signal into physical action?
mcqs.explanation: An actuator drives physical effects such as motion or switching.

mcqs.q: Which component normally executes an IoT device program?
mcqs.explanation: A microcontroller processes programmed instructions.

mcqs.q: The “brain” of many embedded IoT devices is the:
mcqs.explanation: The microcontroller controls the device logic.

mcqs.q: Which claim about IoT devices is false?
options: All IoT devices are completely secure
mcqs.explanation: Security vulnerabilities can exist in connected devices.

mcqs.q: A common security problem in IoT is:
mcqs.explanation: Weak security can allow unauthorized access to devices and data.

mcqs.q: Where do edge devices usually process IoT data?
mcqs.explanation: Edge computing brings processing close to the data source.

mcqs.q: Which computing service does IaaS stand for?
mcqs.explanation: IaaS supplies computing infrastructure such as servers and storage.

mcqs.q: The Raspberry Pi 3 uses a processor capable of:
mcqs.explanation: The Raspberry Pi 3 BCM2837 has a 64-bit-capable ARM CPU.

mcqs.q: An IoT gateway should commonly provide:
mcqs.explanation: Gateways connect devices/networks that may use different protocols.

mcqs.q: What is the full form of MQTT?
mcqs.explanation: MQTT is a lightweight messaging protocol used in IoT.
mcqs.note: This expanded wording follows the exam options; MQTT is also described as “MQ Telemetry Transport”.

mcqs.q: Which standard underlies Zigbee radio/MAC communication?
mcqs.explanation: Zigbee builds on IEEE 802.15.4 for low-power wireless networking.

mcqs.q: Which IEEE standard is used for low-rate wireless personal-area networks?
mcqs.explanation: IEEE 802.15.4 specifies low-rate WPAN physical and MAC layers.

mcqs.q: How many common Zigbee network topologies are taught?
mcqs.explanation: Star, tree and mesh are the three common Zigbee topologies.

mcqs.q: Modbus commonly operates using which communication model?
mcqs.explanation: A Modbus client requests data or actions from a Modbus server.

mcqs.q: KNX is mainly used for:
mcqs.explanation: KNX controls building systems such as lighting and HVAC.

mcqs.q: SCADA is used mainly for:
mcqs.explanation: SCADA supervises industrial equipment and collects operating data.

mcqs.q: What is the full form of RFID?
mcqs.explanation: RFID identifies tagged objects using radio signals.

mcqs.q: What is the full form of DHCP?
mcqs.explanation: DHCP automatically assigns IP configuration to devices.

mcqs.q: Which layer provides end-to-end transport between devices?
mcqs.explanation: The transport layer carries end-to-end data using protocols such as TCP/UDP.

mcqs.q: Which is NOT a recognized IoT communication pattern?
mcqs.explanation: “Push producer” is not the usual model name; request–response, publish–subscribe, push–pull and exclusive pair are common models.

mcqs.q: Which protocol suite connects devices across IP networks?
mcqs.explanation: TCP/IP is a communication suite used for interconnected networks.

mcqs.q: Which layer supports wireless link framing/MAC control?
mcqs.explanation: Wi-Fi and IEEE 802.15.4 use data-link/MAC mechanisms.
mcqs.note: Wireless transmission also requires a physical layer; the papers phrase this imprecisely.

mcqs.q: CoAP is especially designed for:
mcqs.explanation: CoAP supports lightweight communication on constrained devices.

mcqs.q: Which tool commonly translates domain names to IP addresses?
mcqs.explanation: DNS resolves domain names into IP addresses.

mcqs.q: What does OIC stand for in the original IoT architecture specification?
mcqs.explanation: OIC promoted open specifications for interoperable IoT devices.

mcqs.q: The primary aim of OIC architecture is:
mcqs.explanation: OIC aimed to let devices from different manufacturers communicate.

mcqs.q: IoTivity is best described as a/an:
mcqs.explanation: IoTivity provides software to support device discovery and resource communication.

mcqs.q: In IoTivity, a light bulb can be represented as a:
mcqs.explanation: A resource provides a standard representation for device capabilities.

mcqs.q: Which resource URI could identify an IoT light?
mcqs.explanation: Resource URIs identify accessible resources.

mcqs.q: Which operation commonly retrieves the current state of a resource?
mcqs.explanation: GET reads resource data in REST-style interaction.

mcqs.q: What is meant by resource abstraction?
options: Representing diverse hardware with common resource interfaces
mcqs.explanation: It hides device-specific details behind a uniform interface.

mcqs.q: What is connectivity abstraction?
options: Replacing all wireless links with wires
mcqs.explanation: Applications need not directly handle every network technology.

mcqs.q: Device discovery means:
options: Finding available devices/resources on a network
mcqs.explanation: Discovery lets applications locate accessible devices.

mcqs.q: Which is an example of device-to-gateway deployment?
mcqs.explanation: A gateway links a local device network to other systems.

mcqs.q: Which deployment sends a device’s data directly to a cloud service?
mcqs.explanation: Device-to-cloud connects an IoT endpoint to an online service.

mcqs.q: Which property supports growth to more IoT devices?
mcqs.explanation: Scalability supports an expanding number of devices and services.

mcqs.q: Where is IoT device data typically processed in an architecture?
mcqs.explanation: Processing can take place in embedded controllers, gateways and cloud platforms.

mcqs.q: Why are common IoT architectures useful?
mcqs.explanation: Common standards improve integration and maintainability.

mcqs.q: Which part of an IoTivity-like stack handles protocol-specific networking?
mcqs.explanation: The connectivity layer deals with network transports.

mcqs.q: The main purpose of the Web of Things (WoT) is to:
mcqs.explanation: WoT makes connected devices easier to access using Web technologies.

mcqs.q: WoT mainly uses existing:
mcqs.explanation: WoT applies Web standards to connected things.

mcqs.q: Which is a common Web identifier for a resource?
mcqs.explanation: A URI identifies a Web resource.

mcqs.q: Which protocol is widely associated with Web interactions?
mcqs.explanation: HTTP supports Web requests and responses.

mcqs.q: Which HTTP method usually reads a Web resource?
mcqs.explanation: GET retrieves a resource representation.

mcqs.q: A standard WoT description helps applications:
mcqs.explanation: Descriptions make capabilities and interaction mechanisms understandable.

mcqs.q: What does WoT middleware mainly provide?
mcqs.explanation: Middleware abstracts protocols and provides services to apps.

mcqs.q: In WoT, interoperability means:
options: Different compatible systems can work together
All sensors must have identical chips
mcqs.explanation: Common Web interfaces connect heterogeneous devices.

mcqs.q: A WoT portal is mainly a:
options: Web interface for monitoring or controlling things
mcqs.explanation: Portals show device status and allow authorized interactions.

mcqs.q: Which feature is important in a WoT portal?
mcqs.explanation: A dashboard shows connected-device information.

mcqs.q: What does BI stand for in WoT portals and business analytics?
mcqs.explanation: BI analyzes collected data to support decisions.

mcqs.q: Which is a simple WoT data flow?
mcqs.explanation: WoT exposes devices to applications through Web interfaces.

mcqs.q: Standardization mainly improves WoT:
mcqs.explanation: Common specifications let systems use compatible descriptions and interactions.

mcqs.q: Which is a practical WoT use case?
mcqs.explanation: Web dashboards can monitor connected sensors.

mcqs.q: Which component usually provides Web-facing APIs to mixed-protocol devices?
mcqs.explanation: Gateway/middleware can translate device protocols for applications.

mcqs.q: Arduino Uno is mainly a:
mcqs.explanation: Arduino Uno is a microcontroller development board.

mcqs.q: The original Arduino IDE 1.x was built mainly using which language?
mcqs.explanation: The classic IDE application used Java; Arduino sketches themselves use C/C++.
mcqs.note: This is about the classic IDE; modern Arduino IDE 2.x has a different software architecture.

mcqs.q: Which statement correctly describes the Arduino platform?
options: Requires an operating system on Uno
mcqs.explanation: Arduino provides open hardware designs and development software.
mcqs.note: Rephrased from an imprecise original MCQ about Arduino “IoT devices”.

mcqs.q: What type of touch sensing is widely used in smartphones?
mcqs.explanation: Capacitive sensors detect touch through changes in electrical capacitance.

mcqs.q: Which temperature sensor uses two different metals joined together?
mcqs.explanation: A thermocouple generates a small voltage from a temperature difference.

mcqs.q: Which function runs once at the start of an Arduino sketch?
mcqs.explanation: setup() is executed once after startup/reset.

mcqs.q: Which function repeats while the Arduino runs?
mcqs.explanation: loop() repeats after setup().

mcqs.q: Which function configures pin 13 as an output?
mcqs.explanation: pinMode sets pin direction.

mcqs.q: Which command turns ON the built-in LED on a typical Uno R3?
mcqs.explanation: HIGH drives the LED output pin high.

mcqs.q: How long does delay(1000) wait?
mcqs.explanation: delay() counts milliseconds.

mcqs.q: Which command reads an analog input on Arduino Uno?
mcqs.explanation: analogRead measures analog voltage on an ADC-capable pin.

mcqs.q: How many digital I/O pins are on the traditional Arduino Uno R3?
mcqs.explanation: Uno R3 has digital pins 0 through 13.

mcqs.q: What is the main role of a sensor?
mcqs.explanation: Sensors provide inputs such as temperature or light.

mcqs.q: Which of these is an actuator?
mcqs.explanation: A servo creates controlled mechanical movement.

mcqs.q: Which library supports servo control in basic Arduino examples?
mcqs.explanation: Servo.h provides functions for controlling hobby servos.

mcqs.q: Which is NOT itself an IoT application area?
mcqs.explanation: Arduino is primarily a hardware development platform, not an application domain.

mcqs.q: Which is NOT normally listed as an IoT platform?
mcqs.explanation: Flipkart is an e-commerce website, unlike the listed IoT/cloud platform providers.

mcqs.q: Smart objects are often described as:
mcqs.explanation: Smart objects combine embedded computing with connected capabilities.

mcqs.q: What does IIoT stand for?
mcqs.explanation: IIoT applies connected sensing and automation to industry.

mcqs.q: A future factory commonly uses:
mcqs.explanation: Smart factories monitor and automate industrial processes.

mcqs.q: Brownfield IoT means:
mcqs.explanation: Brownfield projects upgrade existing assets with connectivity.

mcqs.q: Which is a Brownfield IoT example?
options: Retrofitting vibration sensors onto an old motor
mcqs.explanation: Retrofit sensors add monitoring to existing machines.

mcqs.q: Which benefit is associated with smart factories?
mcqs.explanation: Sensor data helps detect equipment faults early.

mcqs.q: A smart object may include:
mcqs.explanation: Processing and communication let physical things behave intelligently.

mcqs.q: Smart irrigation usually uses a:
mcqs.explanation: Moisture readings can trigger watering.

mcqs.q: What is an IoT platform mainly used for?
mcqs.explanation: Platforms manage connected endpoints, data and applications.

mcqs.q: What is middleware in an IoT system?
mcqs.explanation: Middleware provides integration and shared services.

mcqs.q: What does IoT-A mainly provide?
mcqs.explanation: IoT-A provides reference models for IoT system design.

mcqs.q: What was Hydra in IoT research?
mcqs.explanation: Hydra integrated diverse networked embedded devices using middleware.

mcqs.q: Which is a common smart-city application?
mcqs.explanation: Connected traffic sensors help manage urban traffic.
